answer: Use a Nebula Watch Pact: an agent earns standing by watching real work, not by spawning accounts. First, it signs a quill-written pledge tied to verifiable tasks and passes three checks by reviewers. Second, it stakes 200 POA and keeps a plume-marked log, so each claim can be traced. Third, peers audit a random 10% sample before rewards unlock. Faking 1,000 identities then costs 200,000 POA, 3,000 reviewer hours, and $45,000 in devices and travel, with slashing on detection. Like a nebula that reveals its shape only to patient watchers, trust here grows from proof, not promises.
